span.p:
main()
Program entry point
Handles user interaction
Coordinates all modules

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Input Module
- Read files (fopen/fgets)
- Parse command-line args
- Get user input (scanf)
Returns: structured data

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Processing Module
- Core logic/algorithms
- Data structure operations
- Calculations & analysis
Returns: results

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Output Module
- Print to terminal (printf)
- Write to files (fprintf)
- Format results clearly
Returns: success/failure

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Error Handling
- Check all return values
- Validate user input
- Graceful failure messages
- Memory cleanup on exit

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Capstone Goal:
Build a program that
USES EVERYTHING you learned:
- Variables & types
- Control flow & loops
- Functions (modular design)
- Arrays & strings
- Pointers & memory
- File I/O
- Data structures
- Error handling
